name: kimi-ntfy
description: Push notifications via ntfy.sh when a Kimi Code session, turn or sub-agent ends. English by default; Spanish optional. Self-hosted server supported.
author: Israel Roldan

interface.shortDescription: ntfy.sh push notifications on session/turn end. English with Spanish.
interface.longDescription: Sends an ntfy.sh push when the agent ends a turn, fails a turn, closes the session, or finishes a sub-agent (toggle). Supports ntfy.sh and self-hosted servers.
